name: Arcads
summary: Platform for generating UGC-style video and image ads with AI actors.
description: Arcads generates user-generated-content style video ads and images for marketing teams, using AI actors and third-party video models such as Seedance, with features organised by industry. The site offers demos and sign-up. The pricing page did not load during this check, so no price was recorded. A limited-time offer during this check gave seven days of unlimited generations with a new video model for subscribers. The service is aimed at marketing teams producing large numbers of ad variations.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Arcads' help center describes a 72-hour trial that requires a card, then paid plans (Starter, Creator, Pro, Scale and Business). That article does not publish a dollar price.

howToUse.title: Open Arcads
howToUse.description: Go to Arcads, choose Login or Sign up, then choose Create Your AI Ad. Demos are offered on the site.

howToUse.title: Generate the ad
howToUse.description: Pick AI actors and a third-party video model such as Seedance, then generate images and video ads in a user-generated-content style. Features are organised by industry.

howToUse.title: Refine variations
howToUse.description: Edit, translate or extend the video, then make further ad variations for the marketing team. Subscribers can take the limited-time offer of seven days of unlimited generations on the new video model. Fair use terms are stated on the page.
